annotation.bound_parties_text: The specification's "shalls" apply to DAA system integrators/applicants, who are responsible for all requirements, with other actors such as DAA system designers and flight control designers expected to use it.
annotation.bound_parties_quote: Except for DAA system integrators for whom all the “shalls” in this specification apply, not all aspects of this specification are relevant to all actors/contributors.
annotation.legal_effect_quote: Ultimate determination of applicability will be governed by the appropriate civil aviation authority (CAA).
annotation.robot_provision_quote: This specification applies to uncrewed aircraft (UA) with a maximum dimension (for example, wingspan, disc diameter)
